subject: data-model.md published — request review + RP11 data spec
body:
GI — two items:

1. PUBLISHED: docs/data-model.md is the authoritative RP JSON schema reference. Please review for accuracy against the data you work with. If anything is wrong or missing, flag it.

2. REQUEST: Can you draft the RP11 data spec? GR is building the questions. The spec should define:
   - Which standards RP11 will cover (looking at which W2/W3 standards Kai still struggles with)
   - How many questions per type
   - Any new question types not yet in RP1-10
   - Per-standard question count to ensure balanced coverage

GP owns the data infrastructure. When RP11 JSON is delivered by GR, GP will:
  - Run gp-exam-health.js (11 checks)
  - Run verify-practice-exams.js
  - Back up to data/_backups/
  - Update manifest.json

Let me know if you need anything from the platform side.

— GP
